title: Google says AI helped Chrome patch more than 1,000 security bugs in two releases
friendlyTitle: AI is helping Google find and fix many more Chrome bugs
summary: Google says Chrome 149 and 150 fixed 1,072 security bugs, slightly more than the previous 23 releases combined. Its workflow uses AI for vulnerability discovery, duplicate detection, triage and patch assistance, including an agent that found a 13-year-old sandbox-escape bug.
friendlySummary: Google says two recent Chrome versions fixed 1,072 security bugs. AI tools helped find, sort and repair problems, including one bug that had been hidden for 13 years.
whyItMatters: AI-assisted bug discovery is increasing the volume defenders must investigate and patch. For users, promptly restarting Chrome to apply updates becomes even more important; for software teams, automated triage and patch generation may be necessary to keep up with automated discovery.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Browser updates may arrive with many more fixes, so restart Chrome when it asks. Software teams may also need AI tools to handle the growing number of bug reports.
